npc.cobblemonworld.professor_hale.greeti: Welcome. Mira can heal your team; Ren sells supplies. Then challenge Mara Voss.
npc.cobblemonworld.professor_hale.repeat: Ready for Mara? Check your team and bring a few Potions.
npc.cobblemonworld.mara_voss.greeting: Show me how you handle your team.
npc.cobblemonworld.mara_voss.repeat: Good battle. Dr. Orin is your next challenge.
npc.cobblemonworld.dr_orin.greeting: Mara sent you? Let’s test what you learned.
npc.cobblemonworld.dr_orin.repeat: Head to Town 3. Rook knows about the Black Card.
npc.cobblemonworld.rook.greeting: Win this battle and the Black Card is yours.
npc.cobblemonworld.rook.repeat: Keep that card. You’ll need it when you meet Marlow.
npc.cobblemonworld.selene_kade.greeting: Let’s see whether your plan holds up in battle.
npc.cobblemonworld.selene_kade.repeat: The Town 5 Warden is next. Don’t underestimate him.
npc.cobblemonworld.sixth_warden.greeting: You’ve come a long way. Earn your next win.
npc.cobblemonworld.sixth_warden.repeat: Team Rocket controls the Town 6 laboratory. Clear the base, then find Iris.
npc.cobblemonworld.rocket_grunt_01.greet: Stop. You’re not entering this base.
npc.cobblemonworld.rocket_grunt_02.greet: One win won’t get you through.
npc.cobblemonworld.lab_scientist_iris.gr: Thank you. Take these records to Marlow; he can identify your Black Card.
Iris’s records match your card. Finish the Town 7 challenge, then go to the harbour in Town 8.
Liora manages the final town qualifier.
npc.cobblemonworld.seventh_warden.greeti: One more town after this. Keep your focus.
npc.cobblemonworld.seventh_warden.repeat: Find Marshal Liora at the Town 8 harbour.
npc.cobblemonworld.harbour_marshal_liora: Your seven-town record is confirmed. Captain Dorian will judge the final qualifier.
Dorian is ready. Win his qualifier to enter the Battle Tower.
npc.cobblemonworld.captain_dorian.greeti: The harbour rewards a steady hand. Show me yours.
npc.cobblemonworld.captain_dorian.repeat: Eight towns, eight wins. Mina can now register you at the Battle Tower.
npc.cobblemonworld.battle_tower_receptio: Eight towns complete. You’re registered for the Tower. Rowan is first.
npc.cobblemonworld.battle_tower_trainer_: Welcome to the Tower. Let’s see how you adapt.
You won. The next challenge is open.
Rowan cleared you. I won’t make this easy.
You won. The next challenge is open.
Win here and the Royal League will accept you.
You won. The next challenge is open.
npc.cobblemonworld.royal_league_receptio: The Tower has qualified you. Face Cassian, Seraph and Kael in order, then the Champion.
npc.cobblemonworld.league_elite_01.greet: The Elite challenge starts here. Stay focused.
npc.cobblemonworld.league_elite_01.repea: You won. The next challenge is open.
npc.cobblemonworld.league_elite_02.greet: Cassian tested your strength. I’ll test your choices.
npc.cobblemonworld.league_elite_02.repea: You won. The next challenge is open.
npc.cobblemonworld.league_elite_03.greet: One last Elite battle. Aurelia is watching.
npc.cobblemonworld.league_elite_03.repea: You won. The next challenge is open.
npc.cobblemonworld.aurelia.greeting: You’ve beaten all three Elite trainers. Now face the Champion.
npc.cobblemonworld.aurelia.repeat: You’ve earned your place. Bran will welcome you at the School of Wolf.
npc.cobblemonworld.school_wolf_gatekeepe: Champion, you may enter. Fen is your first trial.
npc.cobblemonworld.school_wolf_trainer_0: The School values patience. Show me yours.
You won. The next challenge is open.
Fen let you through. Keep that focus.
You won. The next challenge is open.
Vargan is next if you can beat me.
You won. The next challenge is open.
npc.cobblemonworld.school_wolf_master.gr: One final trial. Make every decision count.
npc.cobblemonworld.school_wolf_master.re: You passed. Read the TOBA record and follow the meeting marked on your phone.
npc.cobblemonworld.mysterious.greeting: You want my name? Win this battle first.

story.cobblemonworld.chapter_03_house_of: Defeat Rook and receive the Black Card.
story.cobblemonworld.chapter_06_seventh_: Clear the Rocket base. Meet Iris and Marlow, then defeat the Seventh Warden.
story.cobblemonworld.chapter_07_false_vi: Register with Liora, then defeat Captain Dorian to finish the eight-town circuit.
story.cobblemonworld.battle_tower.title: Battle Tower
story.cobblemonworld.battle_tower.object: Register with Mina. Defeat Rowan, Nyx and Orion in order.
story.cobblemonworld.royal_league.title: Royal League

story.cobblemonworld.school_of_wolf.obje: Meet Bran. Pass Fen, Skoll and Hati’s trials, then defeat Master Vargan.
story.cobblemonworld.chapter_08_last_per: Follow the meeting marked on your phone. Discover who is behind the unknown number.

Bring medicine. You’ll face several battles before reaching Iris.

dialogue.cobblemonworld.rook.after_defea: That card is yours now. Selene is your next opponent.
Selene Kade is waiting in Town 4.
Keep the Black Card. Marlow will ask for it later.

dialogue.cobblemonworld.rook.after_card: Marlow will need Iris’s laboratory records to identify it.
dialogue.cobblemonworld.rook.after_card_: Take Iris’s records and the card to Marlow in Town 7.
Clear Team Rocket out of the laboratory before asking Iris for the records.
Marlow will tell you what the card means.
dialogue.cobblemonworld.dr_orin.after_de: Well done. Find Rook in Town 3; he has the Black Card.
Rook runs the Town 3 challenge. Beat him to earn the Black Card.
Rook favors Dark Pokémon. Bring a reliable counter.
Rook is your next opponent. Don’t let him rush your decisions.
dialogue.cobblemonworld.dr_orin.after_ar: Keep the card safe. Marlow can explain its history later.
Marlow can identify the card once Iris has recovered the laboratory records.
Keep the card. You’ll need Iris’s records to make sense of it.
Continue the town challenges. The records can wait until the laboratory is safe.
dialogue.cobblemonworld.mara_voss.after_: Good match. Orin will help you prepare for Town 2.
Find Dr. Orin in Town 2. I’ve sent him your result.
Orin uses Electric Pokémon. A Ground type will help.
Good luck with Orin. You’ve earned this chance.
Orin has your recommendation. Good luck with the next challenge.
Heal your team and restock before travelling.
See you after your next win.
dialogue.cobblemonworld.aurelia.after_de: You’ve won the Royal League. Bran is expecting you at the School of Wolf.
Find Bran at the School of Wolf. He’ll admit the Royal League Champion.
The School trials are tougher than the League. Review your team first.
You’ve earned the title. Now show Bran what you can do.
dialogue.cobblemonworld.aurelia.after_be: The School’s trials will test your team in a different way.
Pass Fen, Skoll and Hati before challenging Master Vargan.
Prepare answers to several team types. Each trial is different.
Vargan keeps the TOBA record. Earn his trust in battle.
